bridge.sentence: Jul 2026: Profit €11k but cash €45k — customers owed €229k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €192k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €114k paid to tax authority; €96k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Aug 2026: Profit +€56k but cash +€79k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €11k, collecting more than was invoiced; €1,095k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €96k paid to tax authority; €1,009k paid for stock or other timing items.
Sep 2026: Profit +€52k but cash €390k — customers owed €835k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €412k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Oct 2026 (forecast): Profit +€109k but cash €1,104k — customers owed €353k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €928k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €103k paid to tax authority; €150k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Nov 2026 (forecast): Profit +€68k but cash €164k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €267k, collecting more than was invoiced; €503k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €96k paid to tax authority; €80k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Dec 2026 (forecast): Profit €60k but cash €39k — customers owed €559k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €261k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €123k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €462k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).
